title: Research Essay
description: Write a comprehensive essay on the given topic
instructions:
This essay should be 2000-2500 words, properly cited using APA format.

Requirements:
- Clear thesis statement
- Well-structured arguments
- Minimum 5 academic sources
- Proper citations and bibliography
- Original work (will be checked for plagiarism)

rubric_criteria.name: Content & Research
rubric_criteria.description: Depth of research and quality of sources
